run_knowledge_teacher: run the KnowledgeTeacher multi-task teacher to train on all 13 SeeKeR knowledge datasets at once
run_woi_knowledge_teacher: run the WoiKnowledgeTeacher to train on Wizard of Internet data with document chunking and dropout mutators
run_wow_knowledge_teacher: run the WowKnowledgeTeacher to train on Wizard of Wikipedia data with passage filtering and sentence selection mutators
run_nqopen_dialogues_knowledge_teacher: run the NQOpenDialoguesKnowledgeTeacher to train on Natural Questions Open data matched with Wizard of Wikipedia dialogues
run_msc_knowledge_overlap_teacher: run the MSCKnowledgeOverlapTeacher to train on Mind Small Talk data with selected sentence knowledge and retrieved document mutators
